scope.question: Same-strategy cross-model comparison (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vs MiMo-V2.6-Flash) on the frozen split-v1 test sets, plus a separate within-model strategy axis.
scope.cells: 2 models x 3 strategies x 2 tasks = 12 runs

design.model_axis: Within each (dataset, strategy) cell, both models see the same frozen units; comparisons are paired by unit (function or pair) and clustered by project (independent) or pair (pairs).
design.strategy_axis: Within each model and dataset, direct/few-shot/context see the same units; comparisons are paired and clustered the same way.
design.axes_are_not_pooled: Model and strategy are two factors in one 2x3 design. No pooled 'overall winner' is computed; differences are reported per cell and an exploratory difference-in-differences is reported.

primary_endpoints.independent_detection: strict end-to-end accuracy (invalid counted wrong) and macro-F1 on the complete-case cohort
primary_endpoints.pairs: joint discrimination accuracy (DA) on all pairs (invalid pair counted wrong), with DA on the both-valid cohort as secondary
primary_endpoints.repair: schema-valid rate and complete-and-changed rate over all planned repair requests

design.inference: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap (seed 42), exact McNemar, Holm within each dataset x endpoint family; bootstrap CI is the main interval, McNemar is secondary.

warnings: The model axis is post-hoc: research/evaluation_protocol.md pre-registered a fixed-base-model strategy comparison; the MiMo arm was added after the DeepSeek test runs.

DeepSeek run-level cost records did not apply the cached-input discount (response.cost.cached_prompt_tokens=0 even when usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens>0). The reported DeepSeek totals are therefore higher than a cache-aware recomputation from the same usage; both are reported.
DeepSeek direct_independent reused 105 cached responses; its latency and cost are partly replayed from earlier identical requests. Other runs have 0 cache hits.
MiMo few-shot independent made 2 API attempts beyond the 288 planned records (retries=2); counts.records remain 288 and missing_requests=0.
Repair structure metrics are proxies (complete function and changed text), not correctness, security equivalence, compilation, or test evidence.

The MiMo tolerant-parse view maps is_vulnerability/is_vulnerative to is_vulnerable and is diagnostic only; it is not an official score. It is reported to show how much of the model gap is schema compliance.

The DeepSeek code-only counterfactual treats missing explanation as optional and re-runs the structural checks on the returned fixed_function; it is diagnostic only and does not change official repair metrics.
The three truncation cases are the same three long functions across both models and all strategies; truncation is an output-budget/input-length failure, not a random model failure.
limitations: One run per (model, strategy, dataset) cell, temperature 0, one model-version snapshot; intervals reflect unit/project sampling, not repeated-run or provider nondeterminism.

Model serving differs in compatibility settings: MiMo uses max_completion_tokens and reasoning_effort=none; DeepSeek uses max_tokens and its non-thinking path. Both are non-reasoning, but tokenizer/chat-template and provider routing differ, so the comparison is between deployed endpoints, not isolated weights.
The independent detection set has 128 vulnerable and 32 non-vulnerable functions; specificity and MCC intervals are wide, and macro-F1 is sensitive to a handful of negative predictions.
The pair task is two independent single-function classifications per pair, not joint A/B reasoning; DA is low for all cells and should not be read as a test of paired reasoning.
Project-cluster bootstrap for independent detection treats 40 projects as exchangeable; pair bootstrap for pairs resamples 180 pairs, not the 60 source projects.

McNemar assumes independent units; within-project correlation can make p-values anti-conservative. Cluster-bootstrap CIs are the primary interval and Holm is applied only within the pre-specified endpoint families.
No repeated seeds, no service-level replication, no human or LLM review of MiMo repairs; repair quality beyond structural proxies is not measured here.
No CWE-family, context-stratum, length-stratum, or position-bias analysis in this file; those are separate analyses.

reproduction.note: The analysis script was executed in WSL outside the repository because this task is scoped to writing only analysis/model_comparison.json and analysis/model_comparison.md. The procedure and all fixed parameters are documented in the Markdown.
